run_diou_loss: run diou_loss to compute Distance IoU loss between two sets of bounding boxes in XYXY format
run_ciou_loss: run ciou_loss to compute Complete IoU loss including aspect ratio and distance penalties
test_diou_loss: test diou_loss with matching boxes to verify it returns near-zero loss
refactor_diou_loss: refactor diou_loss to support batched tensor inputs with arbitrary box dimensions
review_ciou_loss: review ciou_loss for numerical stability with non-overlapping bounding boxes
